items.title: Home Depot (HD) Stock Looks Overvalued On Its 23% Run
items.summary: Home Depot has packed a lot of movement into the past few years, and the share price now asks a simple question of investors. Do the cash flows from this retailer support where the stock currently trades, or has sentiment run ahead of what the business is likely to generate? Over the past 3 years the stock has returned 23.1%, which makes the link between Home Depot's cash generation and today’s valuation especially important for anyone buying in now.
